records.title: Introduction to Persian Literature
records.header: PRSAN 401 Introduction to Persian Literature (5) A&H
records.text: PRSAN 401 Introduction to Persian Literature (5) A&H Selected texts from modern and classical Persian poetry and prose. Provides insights into Iranian culture and its past and present achievements in literature. Prepares the student for a more comprehensive and critical study of Persian literature. Prerequisite: PRSAN 203. Offered: S.
records.schedulingNote: Catalog prerequisites/offering patterns are not current registration permission or guaranteed future offerings.

records.title: Classical Persian Literature: A Survey
records.header: PRSAN 402 Classical Persian Literature: A Survey (5) A&H
records.text: PRSAN 402 Classical Persian Literature: A Survey (5) A&H History of Persian literature from Rudaki to Hafiz. Studies epic, lyric, and mystic traditions placed in historical settings. Covers the most important genres such as the Qasida, the Ghazal, the Ruba' i and the Masnavi. Prerequisite: PRSAN 203. Offered: S.
records.schedulingNote: Catalog prerequisites/offering patterns are not current registration permission or guaranteed future offerings.

records.title: Modern Persian Literature: A Survey
records.header: PRSAN 403 Modern Persian Literature: A Survey (5) A&H
records.text: PRSAN 403 Modern Persian Literature: A Survey (5) A&H Development of poetry and prose after Iran felt and absorbed the impact of Western cultures. Periods and genres. Works of such authors as Jamalzadeh, Hedayat, Dehkoda, Al-e Ahmad, Nima, Sepehri, and Forugh. Prerequisite: PRSAN 203.
records.schedulingNote: Catalog prerequisites/offering patterns are not current registration permission or guaranteed future offerings.

records.text: PRSAN 404 Critical Readings in Modern Persian (5) Designed to develop critical reading and writing skills. Heavily focused on literary texts. Prerequisite: PRSAN 203. Offered: S.

records.title: The Epic Tradition in Iran
records.header: PRSAN 454 The Epic Tradition in Iran (3) A&H
records.text: PRSAN 454 The Epic Tradition in Iran (3) A&H Focuses on the Shahnameh of Firdawsi: explores the ancient legends that gave rise to it and follows the fortunes of epic poetry after Firdawsi, touching on the rise, development, and decline of romance in classical Persian literature. Prerequisite: PRSAN 423.
records.schedulingNote: Catalog prerequisites/offering patterns are not current registration permission or guaranteed future offerings.

records.title: The Persian Ghazal
records.text: PRSAN 455 The Persian Ghazal (3) A&H The Ghazal as the leading medium for lyrical expression in classical Persian tradition. Follows this genre from conception to culmination in the poetry of Hafiz. Conventions and devices of the Ghazal. Development placed in historical and social context. Prerequisite: PRSAN 433.

records.title: Sufism: Thought and Expression
records.header: PRSAN 456 Sufism: Thought and Expression (3) A&H/SSc
records.text: PRSAN 456 Sufism: Thought and Expression (3) A&H/SSc Dynamics of mystical thought and expression as evolved in the writings of the great Sufi masters and reflected in the poetry of Sana' i, Attar, Rumi, and others. The fundamental unity of the mystical vision, with special attention to the peculiarities of individual style and expression. Prerequisite: PRSAN 433.
